info.name: Recognize LLM companion
info.summary: Settings page for the Recognize LLM ExApp, and shows its image descriptions in Files and Memories
info.description:
Companion to the **Recognize LLM** ExApp. ExApps can register settings forms but not an administration *section*, so this app only declares the "Recognize LLM" section; the ExApp fills it with its forms. Without this app the ExApp's forms appear under Administration → Additional settings instead.
It also shows the description the ExApp generates for each image: a **Description** tab in the Files sidebar, and a Description block at the top of the Info panel in Memories. It stores nothing and has no settings of its own.
info.author: gnome
